sources.quote:
## November 18, 2025

- Launched the first Gemini 3 series model, `gemini-3-pro-preview`, our
  state-of-the-art reasoning and multimodal understanding model with powerful
  agentic and coding capabilities.
sources.supports: Google dates the Gemini 3 Pro Preview launch to November 18, 2025; the launch entry gives no pricing details.
Google's developer announcement was published on November 18, 2025, but the captured page does not specify Gemini 3 Pro API token prices or a pricing effective time.

notes: The available primary Google sources establish the model's launch date but do not state its token prices or when any tiered pricing took effect. The supplied current pricing page and changelog do not provide a dated pricing history, and the available archive snapshots do not bracket November 2025, so the classification and effective date remain unclear.
